block_title: Fall Semester Midterm Practice · Quantifiers & rules of inference

questions.prompt: In order, what are the truth values of ∀x ∃y P(x,y); ∃y ∀x P(x,y); ∃x ∀y P(x,y); ∀y ∃x P(x,y)?
questions.context:
Both domains are D = {1, 2, 3}. P(x,y) is true at the 1 entries of this table (rows x, columns y):
1 0 0
0 1 0
0 0 1
hints: For ∀x∃y inspect every row; for ∃y∀x find one column that works in every row.
State the domain and all hypotheses explicitly. Work out the result before comparing the four choices.

explanation.learning_objective: Track witness dependence, quantifier order, and counterexamples on a finite domain.
explanation.correct_rationale: The four tests are: no empty row; an all-1 column; an all-1 row; no empty column. Applying these tests gives T, F, F, T.

incorrect_rationales.rationale: This alternative fails the required condition. The four tests are: no empty row; an all-1 column; an all-1 row; no empty column. Applying these tests gives T, F, F, T.
